title.narrative: IMPACT - Inclusive Movement Building for Peace: Women as Agents for Change and democratic Transformation - TEST

description.narrative: The Kvinna till Kvinna Foundation supports women’s civil society organisations (WCSOs) and women human rights defenders (WHRDs) in conflict-affected contexts to build peaceful, stable, secure, equal and just societies. Aligned with UN Security Council Resolution 1325 and the broader Women, Peace, and Security (WPS) Agenda, this program seeks to enhance the capacity of WCSOs and create a more supportive environment for their work. By operating directly in conflict-affected areas, we aim to amplify the influence and power of all women. In close collaboration with WCSOs, we strive to defend women’s rights, advance gender equality and justice, and contribute to lasting peace. While years of advocacy and grassroots activism have driven progress— improving legislative frameworks, increasing women’s participation, and strengthening rights—these hard-earned gains are under attack. Escalating militarisation, democratic decline, rising violent conflicts and authoritarianism, climate emergencies, and resurgent nationalism are reversing progress and putting WHRDs at greater risk. In response to these attacks, our programme strengthens women’s power and resilience in these increasingly volatile places. We work in “conflict-affected” contexts, encompassing various conflict situations at different stages, with varying degrees and types of violence—from open warfare or sporadic altercations in unresolved conflicts to more stable post-conflict situations with ongoing peacebuilding efforts. As part of this programme, we will work in four regions: the Middle East and North Africa, the South Caucasus and Eastern Europe, sub-Saharan Africa, and the Western Balkans. Within each region, we have identified key countries and contexts where we will support WCSOs, as outlined in this application. These contexts are all affected by repression and shrinking democratic and civic rights of varying degrees. Kvinna till Kvinna’s overall objective is: A world of peace and justice in which women have equal rights, power and opportunities. In our global strategy for 2023-2029, we identify four thematic long-term areas of change, which also form the basis of the programme in focus for this application. They will pave the way for a set of structural changes that this programme will contribute to which are fundamental to fulfilling the rights of all women. Our four strategic areas of change are: • Feminist peace • Equal political and economic rights • Gender-based violence and sexual and reproductive health • Inclusive feminist movements
